en: I have made contact, $n. It is Lokholar the Ice Lord. He has deemed our cause worthy - our earth bound sacrifice sufficient. He comes soon... prepare yourself.

Over a thousand years ago a group of troll priests known as the Atal'ai attempted to bring back an ancient blood god named Hakkar the Soulflayer. After the resulting civil war the priests were defeated and exiled to the Swamp of Sorrows. There they erected a temple to Hakkar to prepare for his arrival into the physical world. The dragon Aspect Ysera soon learned of the Atal'ai's plans and smashed the temple beneath the marshes. To this day, the temple's ruins are guarded by the mighty green dragons.
I wish to join the battle!
Here fishy fishy. . . come to papa.
The Hippogryph is a noble beast, proud and swift.  They are an honor to train, and can quickly take their rider a great distance.
This blue leather does draw the eye, I know. You see, we have a great many eager recruits running around here, hunting and slaying with more enthusiasm than wisdom. One must take precautions.
Kyra Windblade wields her blade with great skill.  She should be able to provide you with some training.  You'll find her at the Inn in Dolanaar.

We most definitely do not need anymore attention drawn to us, stranger. Return to those that sent you in search of the lost master and tell them that nothing could be found. When this is done - and I will know when it is so - return and I shall reveal the secrets of the deceased.

Well, I declare! It's a new student! I'll gladly teach you everything I know once you have a little more skill. Go talk to Gretta Finespindle over there, would you? She'll have you up to speed in no time.
This may come as a shock to you, but business hasn't been all that good as of late...
Leave nothing behind!
I have waited long enough. Now you face the harvester of souls.
Death to you, $n. How dare you come within a bow's shot of me!
I wish to browse your wares.
I never feel warm anymore...
Nope, don't think there are any Enchanters here in Elwynn Forest.  There's a guy named Lucan who runs a shop up in Stormwind though.  You could check with him and see if he will train you.
How many more supplies do we need?

The journal of Jandice Barov is filled with rantings and ravings about the undead. Towards the end of the book is what appears to be a tailoring pattern for the creation of a felcloth bag. This bag is used by warlocks to store soul shards. You already know how to create this bag.
I almost have enough supplies to upgrade to veteran units.
Help me! Save me!
%s mumbles incoherent words.

Well, well, what do you know, sparky, we did it. Everything's collected and ready to go. We're just waiting on those Horde yahoos now, and once they get their act together it's off to the races at Ahn'Qiraj!
Our cause falls on deaf ears beyond the thick, stone walls of Stormwind.
Quid pro quo! I'll teach you what I know, but first I want you to perform a small task...
Follow, $n.  I will soon begin the summoning...
This wooden board holds roughly-made wanted posters.
Great!  Let's keep those supplies coming, people!
Say your prayers!
Very nice, Gerard. Next you will be breeding them.
I am an orc of medicine, $r. If you have come here to learn, I shall do my best to teach.
%s spies you tampering with the camp's fruit stores and attacks you!
If you're trying to be friendly, save your breath.  Better yet, just stop breathing all together.
Not one word....

My lady, I am unworthy of your prayer. Truly, you are an angel of light. Please, assist me in returning to the barrow den so that I may return to the Dream. I, like Malfurion, also have a love awaiting me... I must return to her... to protect her...
You have made our enemies your own.  I will gladly share waters with you.
Go to the Valley of Honor and seek out Xon'cha near the stables.
%s pours the corrupted water onto the cat.
%s laughs as he watches the pests run off.

The Scepter of the Shifting Sands is whole once more, $n.$B$BIt is you who must lead your armies into the cursed fortress city of Ahn'Qiraj and mete justice to its inhabitants.$B$BVenture to Silithus and present the Scepter of the Shifting Sands to Jonathan the Revelator.
Uh oh....
Kneel, Grark.
%s holds high the items $n gave him...
%s gasps.
Bodley, tell me what's going on.
